release-item.p: Skip writing recovery.signal by default for restores of offline backups.

On >= 12, recovery.signal makes fail to start when the backup was made offline with wal_level=minimal. Restore now skips writing it for offline backups unless type is set explicitly, e.g. for Point-in-Time Recovery from an offline backup made with a higher wal_level.

release-item.p: Block incremental stores only the parts of a file that changed since the prior backup instead of the entire file. Enable it with repo-block, which requires repo-bundle. The feature is in beta and also requires the beta option. Do not use it in production: the on-disk format will change before the GA release.
Keep only one all-default group index.

An option that does not apply, e.g. repo2-s3-key when repo2-type is not s3, could add a phantom repository that has only default values. Repository and indexes with only default values are now removed unless no other index remains.

release-item.p: Update config.guess and config.sub to latest versions.
Add explicit instructions for upgrading between 2.x versions.

A new user guide section explains that upgrading between 2.x versions requires only installing the new binaries. Downgrading is also possible when no features unsupported by the older version were used.
Remove references to SSH made obsolete when TLS was introduced.
The help for repo-host, pg-host, and their port options no longer refers to SSH as the only remote protocol. Details about SSH compression were also removed.
